# axe-core 4.14.0 (vendored)

`axe.min.js` and `LICENSE` from the npm package `axe-core@4.14.0`, unchanged
(`https://registry.npmjs.org/axe-core/-/axe-core-4.14.0.tgz`, integrity
`sha512-9WTZxEjsZ7b13TH8JPmbV2z8CHbl80/2hm3XPEG4JgNdQLK81IBRXmSxHfMAOkSqQeRxT/0dwNDz2GOm3zzpcQ==`).
Deque Systems' accessibility engine, under the Mozilla Public License 2.0 (`LICENSE`); the file
keeps its notice.

roll previews runs it in a preview's screenshot session (`src/shot.js`, given to the browser
container on stdin): the page's WCAG violations by rule. To update it, take `axe.min.js` from a
newer package after checking its integrity against the registry's, and change the version here.
